name: Soweto Market
subtitle: A large trading market in western Lusaka, used by retail traders and as a wholesale point for vegetables.

facts.label: Daily activity
facts.value: Traders under tin roofs start before sunrise

facts.label: Wholesale role
facts.value: Has a wholesale market for fresh produce in Lusaka

facts.label: Street vending nearby
facts.value: Vendors sell outside Soweto Market despite a ban

parts.text: A large trading market in western Lusaka, used by retail traders and as a wholesale point for vegetables. The claim that it is the country's largest was not confirmed in a page I could read.
